Price Rs. 16'50 BrOhTh Op P O PuL fl T|0 N X.Y.JAC0& INTRODUCTION The "Statistical Abstract, Tripura—1966" is the Eighth issue in the series. Like the previous issues, the present issue fulfils the need of making available comprehensive and detailed information relating to the various spheres of social and economic activities in the state. Data relating to the years 1957 to 1966 have been incorporated in the Abstract, except in few cases in which the figures for the earlier years were not available. The figures have been presented throughout in metric units of weights and measures. The various sections of the Abstract are preceded by brief explanatory notes which are intended to be read in conjunction with the tables. The primary sources of data are indicated at the foot of each table. The Statistical Department is grateful to the various Departments and Non-Governmental Organisations which have co-operated in bringing out this publication. Suggestions for its further improvements are wel-come. Dated Agartala, the 19th April, 1968. J. SAHA Senior Statistical Officer, Tripura. the 29th Chaitra, 1889 ( S.
